title: content/gates.yaml — tag-matched gate registry, predicate-tree form (D4/D10)
description: Data-driven gate registry loaded by platform/config into the engine/gates Registry. A gate is a PRECONDITION on actions, selected BY TAG (D4) — never per-action code. Gates are EVALUATED AT PLANNING TIME by the planner against a read-only agent snapshot (ToM[self] stats, per D8), and are NEVER stored on objects, values, or goals (D5: the gate lives on the action side, not the goal/object side). Each gate is a recursive boolean predicate EXPRESSION ('expr'): a leaf compares a stat against a value ({stat,op,value}, reading ToM[self]), a live body scalar ({body,op,value}, NEW v3), or tests action-tag membership ({tag}); composite nodes combine children with {and:[…]}, {or:[…]}, or {not:expr}. A gate's expr evaluating false hides the action from the agent; the action is visible iff EVERY matching gate's expr is true (hard AND across matching gates). Adding a stat / tag / gate is a DATA edit, not a code or schema edit (D10). Identifiers and StatIDs must match docs/core/glossary.md; platform/config cross-checks every referenced StatID against content/stats.yaml. schema_version 3 adds the body-scalar leaf and optional cost_rule (data-contracts §0 incompatible-change bump).

schema_version.description: Bumped 2→3 for the body-scalar leaf + cost_rule additions (data-contracts §0).

gates.description: All gate definitions. Evaluated at planning time against a read-only agent snapshot, never persisted on objects (D5).

identifier.description: Canonical GateID (docs/core/glossary.md identifier pattern). Must start with a letter.

tag.description: An action Tag (family or family:value), e.g. 'uses:Strength', 'norm:transgressive', 'social'. Used both in a gate's 'tags' match list and in a {tag} leaf membership test.

statRef.description: A StatID (cross-checked against content/stats.yaml by platform/config). Always read from ToM[self] (the agent's self-belief) — decisions read self-belief, never Real Stats (D8). gates do NOT correct self-belief toward Real Stats; calibration lives in engine/tom.

bodyScalar.description: A canonical BodyScalar field name (NEW v3): Stamina, Mood, Adrenaline, or Urgency. Cross-checked by platform/config against the known set.

op.description: Comparison operator for a stat or body-scalar leaf.

expr.description: A recursive boolean predicate node. EXACTLY ONE shape: a stat-comparison leaf ({stat,op,value}), a body-scalar leaf ({body,op,value}, NEW v3), a tag-membership leaf ({tag}), or a composite ({and:[…]} | {or:[…]} | {not:expr}). Evaluated at planning time against the agent snapshot + the candidate action's tags; never stored on an object (D5).

body.description: Body-scalar leaf (NEW v3): true iff cmp(AgentSnapshot.<body>, op, value). Reads the live Body scalar — Stamina, Mood, Adrenaline, or Urgency — NOT ToM[self].

value.description: The threshold the stat or body scalar is compared against.

tag.description: Tag-membership leaf: true iff the candidate action carries this exact tag. Lets a gate reference the action's own tags inside its predicate (D4).

and.description: Composite AND: true iff EVERY child expr is true.

or.description: Composite OR: true iff ANY child expr is true.

not.description: Composite NOT: true iff the child expr is false.

gate.description: One gate definition: an id, the action tags it governs (D4), a recursive boolean predicate 'expr', and an optional cost_rule (NEW v3). The gate matches a candidate action iff the action carries ANY tag in 'tags' (empty/absent 'tags' = matches every action). For a matched action the gate's 'expr' is evaluated against the agent snapshot; false hides the action. Evaluated at planning time, never stored on an object/goal (D5).

tags.description: Action tags this gate governs (D4). The gate applies to a candidate action iff the action has ANY of these tags. Omit or leave empty to apply to ALL actions.

cost_rule.description: Optional cost-multiplier rule (NEW v3). A gate with a cost_rule emits its mult when expr is true; its visibility verdict is ALWAYS true (it never hides an action).

mult.description: Cost multiplier emitted when this gate's expr is true (e.g. 0.50 for half cost).
